purpose: The speed and memory anchors the observation battery's compute plan is arithmetic over, each carrying the status of its own evidence. Section 8.1 of the battery spec brackets every wall-clock number from these three anchors; committing them is what makes those brackets auditable instead of remembered.
honesty: Two of the three entries below are CONTROLLER MEASUREMENTS that no run receipt in this repository reproduces. They are recorded here because a number in prose is worse than a number with a status, not because recording them makes them receipts. Each carries the exact artifact that would upgrade it.

wrf_v461_nodes_24rank.evidence: stated in docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-03-obs-verification-battery.md sections 0.1 and 8.1; NO run receipt for it exists at this commit
wrf_v461_nodes_24rank.upgrade_path: one node run of the battery-shape namelist emitted by tools/battery_wrf_node_plan.py, with its rsl.error.0000 timing lines parsed into a gpuwm-battery-wrf-node-timing-v1 receipt committed beside this file

arwen_5090_same_domain.evidence: stated in docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-03-obs-verification-battery.md sections 0.1 and 8.1; NO run receipt for it exists at this commit
arwen_5090_same_domain.upgrade_path: the battery-shape sizing smoke (configs/battery/shape_smoke_3km_thompson_dudhia.toml) writes a gpuwm-prepared-domain-tree-forecast report whose wall_seconds and run_seconds ARE this measurement at the battery's own shape

device_memory_fit.note: Nine points across two cards and a 22x span of grid size. The 5090 point is a single measurement, so the slope is reported as a range and the intercept as a range; the product's own gpuwm.core.preflight.estimate_experiment remains the authority for any specific configuration and this fit is the independent cross-check.

battery_shape.scaling_assumption: linear in cells from each anchor. Stated as an assumption and not a measurement: it is optimistic for MPI halo overhead at smaller grids on the WRF side, and pessimistic for the fixed per-step cost on the GPU side. Every projection below is superseded by this shape's own sizing smoke.

device_memory_gib.note: The 'peak envelope' entries are the Windows WDDM-family envelope the allocation gate compares against measured free VRAM, which is deliberately conservative and is NOT a prediction of observed device peak; the pool request is what the run asks the allocator for. The battery spec's section 8.1 estimate of 10.1-10.6 GiB is the independent fit's answer and agrees with it. Legacy RRTMG costs 1.845 GiB of pool over Dudhia shortwave at this shape.

generator: tools/battery_route_preflight.py for the preflight and projection entries; the anchor entries are read from the committed receipts named above
